verdict.rationale: Relay's own materials describe this exact workflow: upload bills, automate approvals, and pay vendors the way they want to be paid. They also list multi-step approval rules on the pricing page, a support article on setting up payment approvals, and bill pay as a core product feature. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how approval routing works (approver roles, thresholds, sequencing), clarity on which plan unlocks multi-step approvals, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the bill-upload-to-approval-to-payment flow.
